Definition: from G5013; depression (in rank or feeling):--humiliation, be made low, low estate, vile.
BiblicalUsage: Mary calls herself the handmaiden and says God hath regarded the low estate of His handmaiden. Isaiah's suffering servant was taken in His humiliation, and Philip reads it to the eunuch on the road. James tells the rich to rejoice when he is made low, and Paul says Christ shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto His glorious body.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that low estate is not the end of the story: God regards it, Christ shared it, and He will change it. My position is that the humiliation of the servant is the road to glory, and the lowly will not stay low forever.
